name: Twenty
description: Modern open source CRM for managing contacts, companies, and sales pipelines.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      PG_DATABASE_URL: "postgres://twenty:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/twenty"
      REDIS_URL: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379"
      SERVER_URL: {{env.SERVER_URL}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      APP_SECRET: {{env.APP_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/server-data:/app/packages/twenty-server/.local-storage
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: twentycrm/twenty-postgres:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: twenty
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: twenty
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
